text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service="model-catalog" severity="P1" — increased inference errors (500s) and tokenizer mismatch for revision r2026-07. Affected routes: /v1/generate-prod, /v1/chat-prod. Error spikes started ~10:00 UTC. Incident URL: https://pagerduty.fake/INC12345

oliver: acked — I'm oncall. pulling logs now. can someone share last deploy?

pd-bot: Alert acknowledged by oliver. Escalation policy: on-call -> prod-eng -> eng-sre.

devon: last automated catalog promotion ran at 09:58 UTC, promotion job id=prom-2026-07-09-0958. Looks like default tokenizer param got swapped to \"tokenizer=v2-bpe\" instead of v2-bpe-legacy in the new rev.

maya: seeing client errors in honeycomb: decoder tokenization failures + truncation exceptions. sample log: `ValueError: tokenizer decode failed at offset 0x1f4` repeated 3000x in 5m window.

oliver: causing 10% of requests to 500 — customer impact: some paid customers report degraded completions. set status P1 and notify support/sales.

liz: creating incident doc & slack thread notes. pinging support to surface affected customers.

oliver: mitigation plan — 1) route traffic away from latest revision to last known-good model rev (r2026-06-98) using catalog route override 2) disable auto-promotion 3) revert catalog defaults and roll back bad revision from promotion job. executing step 1 now.

prod-eng: routing command executed: `curl -X POST https://catalog.internal/api/v1/routes/override -d '{"route":"/v1/*-prod","model_revision":"r2026-06-98","duration":"30m","reason":"rollback after tokenizer mismatch"}'` — response 200. Confirmed gradual shift via metrics. :rocket:

oliver: I'm increasing safe routing to 50% immediate traffic to fallback, will ramp to 100% in 90s if error rate drops. monitoring.

devon: also disabled catalog auto-promotion: `PATCH /api/catalog/config` payload: `{"auto_promote":false}` — applied.

maya: post-routing results: error rate dropped from 9.8% -> 0.6% within 2 minutes. latency steady. KV cache hits normal.

oliver: good — hold on rollback of the revision artifact. @prod-eng can you revoke the promotion and mark revision r2026-07 as quarantined? add note: tokenizer param mismatch.

prod-eng: rev r2026-07 quarantined, promotion revoked, tag added: `quarantine:tokenizer-mismatch`. Also queued a rollback job to remove the bad revision from candidate pool.

devon: root cause: an env-parsing bug in the promotion job that uses an env var TOKENIZER_DEFAULT which was empty for the CI run; fallback logic picked a default alias that maps to a different tokenizer family. working on a PR with validation for tokenizer consistency.

oliver: escalation done. notify customers via support with ETA and mitigation summary. Assigning follow-ups: devon -> PR and postmortem, prod-eng -> revert automation job & add pre-promotion checks, maya -> confirm no latent errors in logs for 24h.

liz: notifying CSM and creating 1:1 customer update drafts. drafting message: "We experienced degraded completions due to a catalog promotion mismatch. Traffic has been routed to a safe revision; we are rolling back the promotion and will follow up with timeline and remediation."

pd-bot: Incident INC12345 marked acknowledged at 10:06 UTC by oliver. PagerDuty note added.

oliver: final note for now — P1 mitigated (traffic rerouted, rev quarantined). Keeping open for follow-up and postmortem. I'll handoff to next oncall in 40m. :white_check_mark:

maya: confirming monitoring alerts lowered. will leave quiet checks in place for 24h.

devon: PR link: https://git.fake/repo/changes/1234 — includes validation tests and a regression test for tokenizer env propagation. request review from prod-eng.

oliver: thanks all. if anything re-fires ping @oliver and re-open pager. closing thread for live mitigation.
